messages:
Lucy Tran: Heads-up — spotted a tiny docs problem in runtime guide: duplicated paragraph in the 'deployment nuances' section + an anchor (#kv-cache) pointing at a removed header. quick eyes? https://redwood/docs/runtime/serving#deployment-nuances

Lucy Tran: There's also a bad inline curl example that still uses `/v1/generate` — should be `/v1/text/generate`. one-line change, but affects many quickstarts.

Mike R: I can take the anchor fix and de-dupe the paragraph. will open a PR.

Anna (Docs): Thanks! can you add a changelog entry and a short note in the frontmatter if you change canonical_url? also ping me so i can run the staging build.

Lucy Tran: will do. PR branch: fix/docs-dup-anchor — i'll add a tiny test and a screenshot link check.

Jamal: small nit on the curl snippet — headers order and endpoint look off. prefer this style for consistency:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwdl-1","prompt":"hi"}'
```

Emma: @Mike R can you add me as a reviewer? i'll do a quick pass for phrasing and accessibility notes.

sre-bot: Link-checker: found 1 broken anchor in /docs/runtime/serving -> /serving#kv-cache (404). Issue created: #3842.

Mike R: assigned to me. will aim to have the PR up by EOD. tagging @Anna (Docs) and @Emma for review.

Anna (Docs): great — once PR is up i will run the local build and verify anchors + TOC.

Lucy Tran: thanks everyone. if you spot any other outdated snippets in runtime guide, drop them here and i'll batch the fixes into the same PR to avoid churn.
